meta.title: 第2套 · 仔细阅读 B

paragraphs.text: A multitasker is one who can perform two or more tasks effectively at the same time, which—apart from the obvious differences—is similar to what a computer does. The concept does indeed come from the realms of technology, where it is used to refer to an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time. However, the question is: can a person really be a multitasker?

sentences.text: A multitasker is one who can perform two or more tasks effectively at the same time, which—apart from the obvious differences—is similar to what a computer does.

analysis.translationLiteral: 多任务处理者是指能够同时有效完成两项或更多任务的人，这——除了明显的差异之外——与计算机所做的相似。
analysis.translationNatural: 所谓“多任务处理者”，就是能同时高效做两件以上事的人；除了显而易见的差别，这跟电脑干的事很像。
analysis.structMarkup: 【A multitasker】 _is_ ~one {who can perform two or more tasks effectively at the same time}~, {which—(apart from the obvious differences)—is similar to what a computer does}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 定语从句（修饰 one）+ 非限制性定语从句（修饰整件事）

components.part: one who can perform two or more tasks effectively at the same time
components.note: one 指“一个人”，后接定语从句；one 在此是代词

components.part: which ... is similar to what a computer does

clauses: who can perform... 是定语从句，修饰 one。
which is similar to what a computer does 是非限制性定语从句，指代前文“同时做多件事”这一行为。
what a computer does 是 what 引导的宾语从句，作 to 的宾语。

phrases.usage: perform 常搭 task/duty/role；同义 carry out。
phrases.example: The system performs three tasks at once. 该系统一次执行三项任务。

phrases.usage: similar 后用 to，不用 with。
phrases.example: Her style is similar to mine. 她的风格和我相似。

phrases.usage: 可表“除了（还有）”或“除了（没有）”，看语境。
phrases.example: Apart from the price, it's perfect. 除了价格，它很完美。

pitfalls: one 在此是代词“一个人”，不是数词，后接定语从句。
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整句意思，不是某个名词。
what a computer does：what 引导宾语从句，不能用 that。
analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇定义“多任务处理者”，并用电脑类比，为后文质疑埋下伏笔。

sentences.text: The concept does indeed come from the realms of technology, where it is used to refer to an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time.

analysis.senseInContext: 执行（execute multiple tasks 执行多个任务）
examples: The system executes commands instantly. 系统立即执行命令。

more.roots: ex-（向外）+ secut（跟随）→ 跟着做完
more.confusables: execute 偏“执行计划/命令/程序”；execution 也可指“处决”

analysis.translationLiteral: 这个概念确实来自技术领域，在那里它被用来指称一个可以同时执行多个任务的操作系统。
analysis.translationNatural: 这个词确实来自技术圈，原本指能同时运行多个任务的操作系统。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The concept】 _does indeed come from_ ~the realms of technology~, {where it is used to refer to an operating system (that can execute multiple tasks at the same time)}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 非限制性定语从句（内含第二层定语从句）

components.note: does 表强调，indeed 加强语气

components.part: where it is used to refer to an operating system
components.note: where 指 in the realms of technology

components.part: that can execute multiple tasks at the same time

clauses: where 引导非限制性定语从句，先行词是 the realms of technology。
that can execute... 是定语从句，修饰 operating system。
be used to refer to 表示“被用来指称”。

phrases.usage: 注意区分 be used to doing（习惯于）。
phrases.example: This tool is used to measure pressure. 这个工具用来测量压力。

phrases.usage: 可指“指的是”“参考”“涉及”。
phrases.example: What does this word refer to? 这个词指什么？

phrases.usage: execute 比 perform 更偏技术；名词 execution。
phrases.example: The program executes the task in seconds. 程序几秒内执行完任务。

pitfalls: does indeed come from：does 是强调用法，不是疑问或否定。
be used to refer to（被用来指）与 be used to doing（习惯于）不同。
where 引导定语从句，先行词是表地点的抽象名词 realms。
analysis.paragraphRole: 交代词源，说明“多任务”原本是技术概念，暗示不宜直接套用于人。

sentences.text: However, the question is: can a person really be a multitasker?

analysis.translationLiteral: 然而，问题是：一个人真的能成为多任务处理者吗？
analysis.translationNatural: 可问题来了：人真的能“多任务”吗？
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表结构 + 冒号后引出疑问句

components.part: can a person really be a multitasker?

clauses: 冒号后是一个独立的疑问句，作 is 的表语内容。
疑问句用部分倒装：can + 主语 + be。

phrases.usage: 后接从句或引语，用于引出核心疑问。
phrases.example: The question is whether we can afford it. 问题是我们是否负担得起。

phrases.usage: multi-（多）+ task（任务）+ -er；动词 multitask。
phrases.example: She's a natural multitasker. 她天生擅长同时处理多件事。

pitfalls: 冒号后是完整疑问句，注意疑问语序 can a person be。
really 放在 be 前，加强疑问语气。
analysis.paragraphRole: 提出全文核心问题：人能否真正多任务，引出后文正反两种观点。

paragraphs.text: For most scientists, the answer is no. So much so that, according to experts in neuroscience, our brains do not handle multitasking situations well. As soon as two tasks require our attention, productivity suffers. What we call multitasking, therefore, is in reality the ability to move more or less quickly from one task to another. This requires two essential conditions: that one of the tasks needs to be automatic, like walking or eating, and that they both need different mental processes. Answering the phone and writing at the same time, for example.

sentences.text: For most scientists, the answer is no.

analysis.translationLiteral: 对大多数科学家来说，答案是否定的。
analysis.translationNatural: 多数科学家的回答是：不能。
clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句。

phrases.usage: 表观点的视角；常置于句首。
phrases.example: For me, this is a big deal. 对我来说这是大事。

phrases.usage: 简洁表态句式；反义 the answer is yes。
phrases.example: For most doctors, the answer is no. 多数医生给出的答案是否定的。

pitfalls: the answer is no 是省略式表语，完整可说 the answer is "no"。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出科学界的直接否定，确立后文要论证的立场。

sentences.text: So much so that, according to experts in neuroscience, our brains do not handle multitasking situations well.

analysis.senseInContext: 神经科学（experts in neuroscience 神经科学专家）
examples: Neuroscience studies how the brain works. 神经科学研究大脑如何运作。

more.confusables: neuroscience 神经科学；psychology 心理学

analysis.translationLiteral: 以至于，根据神经科学专家的说法，我们的大脑并不能很好地处理多任务情境。
analysis.translationNatural: 甚至可以说：按神经科学专家的说法，我们的大脑本来就处理不好“多任务”。
analysis.structMarkup: {So much so that}, (according to experts in neuroscience), 【our brains】 _do not handle_ ~multitasking situations~ (well).
analysis.structureSummary: 程度/结果状语从句 + 主谓宾

components.note: 固定说法“以至于”，承接上句的 no

clauses: so much so that... 是固定结构，表示“到了如此程度以至于……”，承接上一句的 no。

phrases.usage: 用于强化前一句的说法。
phrases.example: He was tired — so much so that he fell asleep at his desk. 他太累了，以至于趴在桌上睡着了。

phrases.usage: handle 及物动词，直接接宾语。
phrases.example: She handled the situation calmly. 她冷静处理了局面。

pitfalls: so much so that 不是“太多了以至于”，而是固定连接结构。
handle 是及物动词，不加 with。
neuroscience 神经科学，neuro- 前缀表“神经”。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用神经科学证据支撑“人不能真正多任务”的判断。

sentences.text: As soon as two tasks require our attention, productivity suffers.

analysis.senseInContext: 生产力、效率（productivity suffers 效率受损）
examples: Remote work can boost productivity. 远程办公能提升效率。

more.confusables: productivity 不可数；product 是产品

analysis.translationLiteral: 一旦两项任务都需要我们的注意力，生产力就会受损。
analysis.translationNatural: 只要两件事同时要你专注，效率就会掉。
analysis.structMarkup: {As soon as two tasks require our attention}, 【productivity】 _suffers_.
analysis.structureSummary: 时间状语从句 + 主句（主谓）

components.part: As soon as two tasks require our attention

clauses: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，“一……就……”。
主句用一般现在时表普遍规律。

phrases.usage: 从句用一般现在时表将来。
phrases.example: Call me as soon as you arrive. 你一到就给我打电话。

phrases.usage: 此处 productivity suffers = 效率下降。
phrases.example: Quality suffers when workers are rushed. 工人赶工时质量会下降。

pitfalls: productivity 不可数，谓语用 suffers。
suffer 此处不及物，意为“受损”，不是“遭受”。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出机制层面的解释：注意力被分割，效率必然下降。

sentences.text: What we call multitasking, therefore, is in reality the ability to move more or less quickly from one task to another.

analysis.translationLiteral: 因此，我们所说的多任务处理，实际上是或多或少快速地从一项任务转移到另一项任务的能力。
analysis.translationNatural: 所以我们说的“多任务”，实际上是“能比较快地在一件事和另一件事之间来回切换”。
analysis.structMarkup: 【What we call multitasking】, (therefore), _is_ ~in reality the ability (to move more or less quickly from one task to another)~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主语从句 + 系表结构 + 不定式作后置定语

components.part: in reality the ability to move...
to move more or less quickly from one task to another

clauses: What we call multitasking 是 what 引导的主语从句，谓语用单数 is。
to move... 是不定式作后置定语，修饰 ability。

phrases.meaning: 我们称之为 X 的东西
phrases.usage: what 引导主语从句，X 是宾语补足语。
phrases.example: What we call luck is often preparation. 我们说的运气往往是准备。

phrases.usage: 程度状语。
phrases.example: The two are more or less the same. 两者大致相同。

pitfalls: what 引导主语从句，谓语用单数 is。
in reality 意为“实际上”，与 in fact 同义。
the ability to do：不定式作 ability 的后置定语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出核心结论：所谓多任务是快速切换，而非真正同时进行。

sentences.text: This requires two essential conditions: that one of the tasks needs to be automatic, like walking or eating, and that they both need different mental processes.

analysis.senseInContext: 自动的（needs to be automatic 必须是自动的）
examples: Breathing is automatic. 呼吸是自动的。

more.roots: auto-（自己）+ mat（动）→ 自己会动
more.confusables: automatic 自动的；automated 被自动化的

analysis.translationLiteral: 这需要两个必要条件：其一，其中一项任务必须是自动的，比如走路或吃饭；其二，两者必须使用不同的心理过程。
analysis.translationNatural: 这种“切换”有两个前提：一是有一件事得是“自动”的（比如走路、吃饭），二是两件事动用的大脑机制不同。
analysis.structMarkup: 【This】 _requires_ ~two essential conditions~: {that one of the tasks needs to be automatic, like walking or eating}, and {that they both need different mental processes}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 冒号后两个并列的同位语从句

components.part: that one of the tasks needs to be automatic
that they both need different mental processes

clauses: 两个 that 从句并列，都是 conditions 的同位语从句，解释具体条件。
like walking or eating 是插入举例，说明 automatic 的含义。

phrases.usage: essential 指“必不可少”；condition 可数。
phrases.example: Trust is an essential condition for teamwork. 信任是团队合作的必要条件。

phrases.meaning: 心理过程、大脑加工过程
phrases.usage: process 可数，常用复数。
phrases.example: Reading and listening use different mental processes. 阅读和听力用不同的心理过程。

pitfalls: 两个 that 都是同位语从句，不是定语从句（不能用 which）。
one of the tasks 作从句主语，谓语用单数 needs。
they both need：both 是同位语，位置在助动词后、实义动词前。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出“能做多任务”的两个前提，说明为什么真正多任务很难。

sentences.text: Answering the phone and writing at the same time, for example.

analysis.translationLiteral: 例如，同时接电话和写字。
analysis.translationNatural: 比如一边接电话一边写字。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Answering the phone and writing at the same time】, (for example)—(省略谓语：are typical examples of multitasking).
analysis.structureSummary: 名词性短语（动名词并列）+ 插入语（省略句）

components.note: 两个动名词并列，作前一句的例证

clauses: 本句是省略句，没有完整主谓，作为上一句的举例（= This is an example of ...）。

phrases.usage: 时间状语；也可表“然而”（转折）。
phrases.example: He was reading and eating at the same time. 他一边看书一边吃东西。

phrases.usage: 可置于句首、句中或句末，需用逗号隔开；书面缩写 e.g.。
phrases.example: Some tasks, for example driving, need full attention. 有些任务，比如开车，需要全神贯注。

pitfalls: 这是省略句，不是语法错误；阅读时按“举例”理解。
Answering 与 writing 是并列动名词，形式需一致。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用具体例子说明“一项自动 + 一项需要专注”的组合。

paragraphs.text: However, on the other side of the coin there are people who maintain that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking. A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance.

sentences.text: However, on the other side of the coin there are people who maintain that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking.

analysis.senseInContext: 坚持认为（maintain that... 坚持主张）
examples: She maintains that the rule is unfair. 她坚持认为这条规定不公平。

more.roots: main（手）+ tain（握持）→ 手持 → 维持
more.confusables: maintain 三义：维持、保养、坚持认为

analysis.translationLiteral: 然而，硬币的另一面是，有人认为成为多任务处理者——或至少看起来是——是可能的。
analysis.translationNatural: 不过硬币也有另一面：有人坚持认为，人是可以多任务的，至少能看起来像。
analysis.structMarkup: (However), (on the other side of the coin) there _are_ 【people】 {who maintain that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking}.
analysis.structureSummary: there be 存在句 + 定语从句（内含宾语从句）

components.part: on the other side of the coin
who maintain that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking

clauses: who maintain that... 是定语从句，修饰 people。
that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking 是宾语从句，作 maintain 的宾语。
or at least seem to be 是插入的让步成分。

phrases.text: the other side of the coin
phrases.usage: 习语，用于引出相反视角。
phrases.example: The other side of the coin is the cost. 另一面是成本问题。

phrases.usage: 后接 that 从句，表坚定主张。
phrases.example: He maintains that he is innocent. 他坚持自己是无辜的。

pitfalls: maintain 在此是“坚持认为”，不是“维护”。
it is possible to be multitasking：it 是形式主语，真正主语是不定式。
or at least seem to be 是插入语，读时先跳过。
analysis.paragraphRole: 引出反方观点，与科学界的否定形成对照。

sentences.text: A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance.

analysis.senseInContext: 视为、认为（perceive this activity as multitasking 把这项活动视为多任务）
examples: People perceive him as honest. 人们认为他诚实。

more.roots: per-（贯穿）+ ceive（抓取）→ 抓住 → 感知
more.confusables: perceive 强调主观认知；notice 是“注意到”

analysis.translationLiteral: 最近一项研究得出结论：无论人们实际上是否真在处理多项任务，仅仅他们自认为在做多任务这一事实，就对他们的表现有积极影响。
analysis.translationNatural: 最近一项研究得出：不管人是不是真的在同时处理几件事，只要**他自己觉得**是在多任务，表现反而会更好。
analysis.structMarkup: 【A recent study】 _concluded_ ~{that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（从句内含让步状语 + 主语带同位语从句）

components.part: that ... has a positive effect on their performance
regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not
components.note: 无论是否真的在处理多任务

components.part: the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking
components.note: 核心词 the mere fact，后接同位语从句

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作 concluded 的宾语。
whether people are actually handling several tasks or not 是 whether 引导的从句，作介词 of 的宾语。
that they perceive this activity as multitasking 是同位语从句，解释 the mere fact。

phrases.usage: 后接名词或从句；同义 irrespective of。
phrases.example: Regardless of the weather, we'll go. 不管天气如何，我们都去。

phrases.usage: perceive 后接 as；同义 regard A as B。
phrases.example: Many perceive silence as agreement. 许多人把沉默视为同意。

phrases.usage: effect 可数，用 a。
phrases.example: Exercise has a positive effect on mood. 运动对情绪有积极影响。

pitfalls: the mere fact that... 是主语（核心词 fact），谓语是 has，不要被中间长从句带跑。
regardless of whether...or not：whether 从句作介词宾语。
perceive as 中的 as 不能省。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出反方证据：主观上认为自己在多任务，就能提升表现。

paragraphs.text: The business perspective offers a different view: multitasking is understood as the ability to adapt to all types of environment within a company and effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame. Indeed, many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking to improve their productivity. From this different perspective, you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices.

sentences.text: The business perspective offers a different view: multitasking is understood as the ability to adapt to all types of environment within a company and effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame.

analysis.senseInContext: 视角、观点（from this different perspective 从这个不同角度）
examples: Try to see it from her perspective. 试着从她的角度看。

more.roots: per-（贯穿）+ spect（看）+ -ive → 看过去的角度
more.confusables: perspective 视角；prospect 前景；perception 感知

analysis.senseInContext: 开展、承担（undertake different activities 开展不同活动）
examples: The team undertook a major study. 团队开展了一项重要研究。

more.roots: under（在下）+ take（拿）→ 承担下来
more.confusables: undertake 过去式 undertook，过去分词 undertaken；undertake to do 意为“承诺做”

analysis.translationLiteral: 商业视角提供了不同的看法：多任务被理解为一种能力——适应公司内各种环境，并在既定时间框架内有效开展不同活动。
analysis.translationNatural: 企业那边看法不一样：他们说的“多任务”是指——能在公司各种环境里适应，并在规定时间内把不同的事都办成。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The business perspective】 _offers_ ~a different view~: 【multitasking】 _is understood as_ ~the ability (to adapt to all types of environment within a company) and (effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame)~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 冒号后的解释句（主谓 + as 短语，内含两个并列不定式）

components.part: multitasking is understood as the ability...
components.note: 被动结构 be understood as

components.part: to adapt to... and effectively undertake...
components.note: 两个并列不定式修饰 ability

clauses: 冒号后是完整的解释句，说明商业视角的定义。
be understood as 意为“被理解为”。
to adapt to... and (to) undertake... 是并列不定式，共用 ability 的修饰关系。

phrases.usage: 被动结构；主动形式 understand A as B。
phrases.example: Success is often understood as wealth. 成功常被理解为财富。

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词；名词 adaptation。
phrases.example: Children adapt quickly to new schools. 孩子很快适应新学校。

phrases.usage: time frame 指时间框架；set 意为“既定的”。
phrases.example: Finish the report within the set time frame. 在规定时间内完成报告。

pitfalls: be understood as 中 as 不能省。
adapt to 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
第二个不定式 undertake 前省略了 to，与 adapt 并列修饰 ability。
analysis.paragraphRole: 引入第三种视角：企业界对“多任务”的定义与科学界不同。

sentences.text: Indeed, many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking to improve their productivity.

analysis.senseInContext: 生产力、效率（productivity suffers 效率受损）
examples: Remote work can boost productivity. 远程办公能提升效率。

more.confusables: productivity 不可数；product 是产品

analysis.translationLiteral: 的确，许多公司寻找擅长多任务的人来提升生产力。
analysis.translationNatural: 所以很多公司确实在招“能同时干几摊事”的人，来提高产出。
analysis.structMarkup: (Indeed), 【many companies】 _look for_ ~people {who are skilled in multitasking}~ (to improve their productivity).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 定语从句 + 目的状语

components.part: people who are skilled in multitasking

clauses: who are skilled in multitasking 是定语从句，修饰 people。
to improve... 是不定式作目的状语。

phrases.usage: 也可 be skilled at；skill 是名词。
phrases.example: She is skilled in negotiation. 她擅长谈判。

phrases.usage: 后接名词；同义 search for。
phrases.example: We're looking for a designer. 我们在找一位设计师。

pitfalls: be skilled in 后接名词或动名词。
to improve 是目的状语，不是定语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用企业招聘实践印证上一句的定义，说明该视角的现实影响。

sentences.text: From this different perspective, you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices.

analysis.senseInContext: 视角、观点（from this different perspective 从这个不同角度）
examples: Try to see it from her perspective. 试着从她的角度看。

more.roots: per-（贯穿）+ spect（看）+ -ive → 看过去的角度
more.confusables: perspective 视角；prospect 前景；perception 感知

analysis.senseInContext: 灵活性（favour flexibility 有利于灵活）
examples: Flexibility helps teams adapt. 灵活性有助于团队适应。

more.roots: flex（弯曲）+ -ibility（能力）→ 可弯曲性
more.confusables: flexibility 不可数；flexible 形容词

analysis.translationLiteral: 从这个不同的角度看，你不仅可以成为多任务处理者，而且这种能力还可以被教授：这在流动性组织中更容易，这些组织倾向于在工作方式上保持灵活性。
analysis.translationNatural: 按这种视角，你不仅能“多任务”，这能力还能被训练出来——在组织结构扁平、工作方式灵活的公司里更容易做到。
analysis.structMarkup: (From this different perspective), 【you】 _can not only be_ ~multitasking~ {but this ability can also be taught}: ~something {that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices}~.
analysis.structureSummary: not only...but also... 并列两个分句 + 冒号后同位语（带两层定语从句）

components.part: you can not only be multitasking
but this ability can also be taught
something that is easier in fluid organisations
which favour flexibility in their working practices

clauses: not only...but also... 连接两个并列分句。
that is easier in fluid organisations 是定语从句，修饰 something。
which favour flexibility... 是非限制性定语从句，修饰 organisations。

phrases.meaning: 流动性组织（结构灵活、边界模糊）
phrases.usage: fluid 本义“流动的”，此处指结构灵活。
phrases.example: Fluid teams adapt faster. 灵活的团队适应更快。

phrases.meaning: 有利于灵活性、偏好灵活
phrases.usage: favour 作动词表“有利于、支持”。
phrases.example: The policy favours small businesses. 该政策有利于小企业。

pitfalls: not only...but also... 两边结构对称（be / can be taught）。
冒号后的 something 是同位语，不是新分句的主语。
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代 organisations（复数），故用 favour。
analysis.paragraphRole: 把企业视角推进一步：多任务不仅可行，还可训练，且有组织条件。

paragraphs.text: The benefits of multitasking are clear. Being quicker and more efficient increases our performance and the number of tasks completed. But having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced and that can lead to more mistakes.

sentences.text: The benefits of multitasking are clear.

analysis.translationLiteral: 多任务的好处是明显的。
clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句。

phrases.usage: benefit 可数，常用复数；反义 drawback。
phrases.example: The benefits of exercise are well known. 运动的好处众所周知。

phrases.usage: 不可数名词；动词 multitask；作定语如 multitasking ability。
phrases.example: Multitasking reduces accuracy. 多任务处理会降低准确度。

pitfalls: benefits 是复数，谓语用 are。
analysis.paragraphRole: 转折过渡：承认多任务确有好处，为下一段说代价做铺垫。

sentences.text: Being quicker and more efficient increases our performance and the number of tasks completed.

analysis.translationLiteral: 更快、更有效率会提升我们的表现以及完成的任务数量。
analysis.translationNatural: 更快、更高效，确实能提高我们的产出和完成的任务量。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Being quicker and more efficient】 _increases_ ~our performance and the number of tasks completed~.
analysis.structureSummary: 动名词短语作主语 + 谓语 + 并列宾语

components.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数
与动名词主语一致，用单数

components.part: our performance and the number of tasks completed

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句。
tasks completed 中 completed 是过去分词作后置定语。

phrases.usage: 谓语用单数（与 a number of 不同，后者用复数）。
phrases.example: The number of users is growing. 用户数量在增长。

phrases.usage: 过去分词作后置定语，= tasks that are completed。
phrases.example: We track the tasks completed each week. 我们每周统计完成的任务。

pitfalls: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 increases。
the number of + 复数名词 作主语时谓语用单数。
completed 是过去分词作定语，不是谓语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 具体说明多任务的正面收益：速度与完成量。

sentences.text: But having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced and that can lead to more mistakes.

analysis.senseInContext: 专注、集中（the powers of concentration 专注力）
examples: Loud music breaks my concentration. 大声的音乐让我无法集中。

more.roots: con-（共同）+ centr（中心）+ -ation → 聚到中心
more.confusables: concentration 名词；concentrate on 动词短语

analysis.translationLiteral: 但同时关注几件事意味着专注力被削弱，而这可能导致更多错误。
analysis.translationNatural: 可一旦要同时盯几件事，专注力就被摊薄，错误也就多了。
analysis.structMarkup: {But} 【having to pay attention to several things at once】 _means_ ~{that the powers of concentration are reduced}~ {and that can lead to more mistakes}.
analysis.structureSummary: 动名词主语 + 谓语 + 宾语从句，and 连接结果分句

components.part: having to pay attention to several things at once

components.note: 意味着（主语为动名词，用单数）

components.part: that the powers of concentration are reduced
and that can lead to more mistakes

clauses: that the powers of concentration are reduced 是宾语从句，作 means 的宾语。
and that can lead to more mistakes 中 that 是指示代词“这”，指代前面整个情况。

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
phrases.example: Pay attention to the details. 注意细节。

phrases.usage: concentration 不可数；powers 表“能力”。
phrases.example: Noise reduces the power of concentration. 噪音会削弱专注力。

phrases.usage: to 是介词，后接名词。
phrases.example: Rushing leads to mistakes. 赶工导致错误。

pitfalls: 第二个 that 是指示代词（这），不是从句引导词——本句只有一个宾语从句。
动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 means。
pay attention to 中 to 是介词。
analysis.paragraphRole: 点出多任务的代价：专注力下降、错误增多，完成辩证收尾。

questions.stem: What does a "multitasker" originally refer to?

options.text: An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once.
A skilled worker executing more than one task at the same time.
A sophisticated technology doing several tasks effectively at once.
An efficient person able to perform multiple tasks at the same time.

questions.stem: Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists?

options.text: They are not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations.
They are not comparable to mechanical operating systems.
Their brains do not allow them to multitask.
Their attention span cannot be expanded.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking?

options.text: People make greater achievements by maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking.
People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking.
People's active mental processes exert a positive effect on their multitasking.
People can improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations.

questions.stem: How does the business world view multitasking?

options.text: It is a rare skill often found in fluid organisations.
It is an adaptable capability required of all workers.
It is an essential quality many employees lack.
It is a desirable ability that can be developed.

questions.stem: What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well?

options.text: Work in a flexible way.
Learn from mistakes.
Avoid multitasking.
Increase efficiency.

multitasker.sense: 能同时处理多任务的人
examples: Can a person really be a multitasker? 一个人真的能一心多用吗？

more.confusables: multitasker（人）/ multitasking（行为）/ multitask（动词）

examples: Computers help students perform better. 电脑帮助学生学习表现更好。

more.confusables: perform（执行/表演）/ performance（表现，名词）

examples: Splitting tasks fairly matters. 公平分担任务很重要。

more.confusables: task（任务）/ work（工作）/ chore（家务杂事）

effectively.sense: 有效地；实际上（= in effect）
examples: Data and instinct together work effectively. 数据与直觉结合效果更好。

more.confusables: effectively（有效地/实际上）/ efficiently（高效地）

time.sense: 时间；次数；时机 / 计时
examples: It takes time to change habits. 改变习惯需要时间。

more.confusables: times（时代）/ time（时间，不可数）

examples: Apart from cost, there are other issues. 除了成本，还有其他问题。

more.confusables: apart from（除……之外）/ besides（此外）

examples: The disadvantage, obviously, is that farmers suffer. 明显的劣势是农民受损。

more.confusables: obvious（明显的）/ obviously（显然）/ apparent（表面上的）

examples: There are clear differences between the groups. 两组之间有明显差异。

more.confusables: difference（差异）/ different（形容词）/ differ（动词）

examples: Men reported similar levels of enjoyment. 男性报告的享受程度相近。

more.confusables: similar to（与……相似）/ the same as（与……相同）

examples: Computers increased students' ability to gather information. 电脑提高了学生收集信息的能力。

more.confusables: computer（电脑）/ calculator（计算器）

examples: The concept of the quantified self is limited. 「量化自我」这个概念有局限。

more.confusables: concept（概念）/ conception（构想/受孕）/ idea（想法）

indeed.sense: 确实、的确（加强语气）；甚至
examples: Indeed, their digital use can be beneficial. 确实，他们的数字使用可以是有益的。

more.confusables: indeed（确实）/ really（真的）/ actually（实际上）

examples: Fewer readers come from that background. 来自那种背景的读者更少。

more.confusables: come（来）/ go（去）

examples: It matters in the realm of work. 这在工作领域很重要。

more.confusables: realm（领域）/ area（领域）/ kingdom（王国）

examples: Many places could benefit from existing technology. 许多地方能受益于现有技术。

more.confusables: technology（技术）/ technique（技巧）/ technical（技术的）

used.sense: use 的过去式/过去分词；（be used to）习惯于；（used to）过去常常
examples: They used flexible work arrangements. 他们使用了弹性工作安排。

more.confusables: used to do（过去常常）/ be used to doing（习惯于）/ be used to do（被用来做）

examples: They refer to this as the third space. 他们把这称作第三空间。

more.confusables: refer to（提及/指称）/ refer to as（称为）/ reference（参考）

operating.sense: 运营的、运作的；operate 的现在分词
examples: Operating costs rose sharply. 运营成本大幅上升。

more.confusables: operating（运营的）/ operation（运营/手术）/ operate（操作/运营）

examples: The legal system is changing. 法律体系在改变。

more.confusables: system（系统）/ systematic（系统的）/ systemic（全身的/体制性的）

examples: They executed the plan carefully. 他们谨慎执行了计划。

more.confusables: execute（执行）/ execution（执行）/ executive（高管）

examples: Multiple factors explain the gap. 多种因素解释了这一差距。

more.confusables: multiple（多个的）/ several（几个）/ multiply（乘/倍增）

however.sense: 然而（副词，须用分号或句号连接）；无论怎样
examples: However, the study also shows a gap. 然而，研究也显示出一道差距。

more.confusables: however（副词，不能像 but 那样直接连两个分句）/ but（连词）

question.sense: 问题（需回答）；疑问 / 质疑
examples: This seemingly easy question drives the need to understand. 这个看似简单的问题催生了理解的需要。

more.confusables: question（疑问）/ problem（难题）/ out of the question（不可能）

examples: Can a person really be a multitasker? 一个人真的能一心多用吗？

more.confusables: person（单数）/ people（复数）/ persons（法律用语复数）

examples: They do not really reflect everyday behaviour. 它们并没有真正反映日常行为。

more.confusables: really（真正地）/ real（形容词）/ actually（实际上）

examples: Social scientists found digital use beneficial. 社会科学家发现数字使用有益。

more.confusables: scientist（科学家）/ science（科学）

answer.sense: 答案、回答（可数）/ 回答；解决
examples: For most scientists, the answer is no. 对多数科学家来说，答案是否定的。

more.confusables: answer to（……的答案，用 to）/ reply to（回复）

examples: According to the study, rates are stable. 根据这项研究，比率稳定。

more.confusables: according to（根据，后接来源）/ because of（因为）

examples: Experts disagree about the cause. 专家对成因看法不一。

more.confusables: experts（专家）/ expertise（专业知识）

examples: Neuroscience shows multitasking limits. 神经科学揭示了多任务处理的局限。

more.confusables: neuroscience（神经科学）/ neurology（神经学）

examples: Our brains cannot truly multitask. 我们的大脑无法真正同时处理多任务。

more.confusables: brains（大脑）/ brain（单数）

examples: Kids must learn to handle online conflict. 孩子必须学会处理网上冲突。

more.confusables: handle（处理）/ deal with（应对）/ cope with（应付）

multitasking.sense: 多任务处理、同时做多件事
examples: Multitasking reduces accuracy. 多任务处理会降低准确度。

more.confusables: multitasking（名词）/ multitask（动词）/ multitasker（多任务者）

examples: Data is impractical in certain situations. 数据在某些情形下不实用。

more.confusables: situation（情形）/ condition（条件/状况）/ circumstance（环境，常用复数）

well.sense: 好地（副词）；健康的（形容词）；井（名词）
examples: Social health matters to overall well-being. 社交健康关系到整体幸福。

more.confusables: well（好地/健康）/ good（好的，形容词）/ as well（也）

examples: He was retired soon after. 他不久后就退役了。

more.confusables: soon（不久）/ early（早）/ quickly（快）

require.sense: 需要、要求（require sb to do / require that）
examples: The job requires careful judgment. 这份工作需要谨慎判断。

more.confusables: require sb to do（要求某人做）/ require doing（需要被做）/ need（需要）

examples: Short forms may shorten attention span. 短形式可能缩短注意力持续时间。

more.confusables: pay attention to（注意）/ attention to（注意）/ attend（参加）

productivity.sense: 生产率、工作效率（不可数）
examples: Multitasking lowers productivity. 多任务处理会降低效率。

more.confusables: productivity（生产率）/ production（产量）/ product（产品）

suffers.sense: suffer 的第三人称单数（遭受）
examples: Local farming suffers under the policy. 当地农业在该政策下受损。

more.confusables: suffers（三单）/ suffer（原形）

call.sense: 称呼（call sb sth）；打电话；呼叫
examples: This is what we call the third space. 这就是我们所说的「第三空间」。

more.confusables: call sb sth（称某人某物）/ call sb up（打电话）/ so-called（所谓的）

examples: The data is limited; therefore instinct matters. 数据有限，因此直觉重要。

more.confusables: therefore（因此，正式）/ so（所以，口语）/ thus（因此，书面）

reality.sense: 现实、实际情况（可数/不可数）
examples: In reality, the female did most of the care. 现实中主要是女性在做照护。

more.confusables: in reality（实际上）/ reality（现实）/ real（真实的）

collocations: to the best of one's ability
examples: The ability to focus is underrated. 专注的能力被低估了。

more.confusables: ability to do（不是 of doing）/ capability（能力，偏完成复杂任务）

move.sense: 移动、搬；促使（move sb to do）；举措
examples: The law is a move towards protection. 这项法律是迈向保护的一步。

more.confusables: move（移动）/ movement（运动/动作）

examples: Attitudes are changing quickly. 态度正在快速改变。

more.confusables: quickly（快速地）/ fast（快，口语）/ rapidly（迅速，正式）

examples: Doing each task well is hard when switching. 切换时把每项任务做好很难。

more.confusables: task（任务）/ work（工作，不可数）/ chore（家务）

requires.sense: require 的第三人称单数（需要）
examples: Good judgment requires experience. 好的判断需要经验。

more.confusables: requires（三单）/ require（原形）

essential.sense: 必不可少的、本质的；要素（复数）
examples: Equal leave is an essential component. 平等休假是不可或缺的一环。

more.confusables: essential to（对……必不可少）/ essential（本质的）/ necessary（必要的）

conditions.sense: 条件；状况、病症（condition 的复数）
examples: Isolation is linked to mental health conditions. 孤立与心理健康问题相关。

more.confusables: condition（状况/病症）/ situation（情形）/ state（状态）

needs.sense: 需求（need 的复数）；需要（动词三单）
examples: The system meets basic needs. 这个系统满足基本需求。

more.confusables: needs（需求/三单）/ need（需要）

examples: Saving is automatic in this app. 这个应用会自动保存。

more.confusables: automatic（自动的）/ automated（被自动化的）/ automatically（自动地）

like.sense: 像（介词）；喜欢（动词）；口语连词「像……那样」
examples: Tools like this save time. 这样的工具能省时间。

more.confusables: like（介词，后接名词）/ as（连词，后接从句）

walking.sense: 步行（不可数）；walk 的现在分词
examples: Walking more improves health. 多走路能改善健康。

more.confusables: walking（步行）/ walk（走）

eating.sense: eat 的现在分词；饮食（不可数）
examples: Healthy eating starts early. 健康饮食从小开始。

more.confusables: eating（饮食）/ eat（吃）

need.sense: 需要（情态/实义动词）；需要、需求（名词）
examples: Parents need to set boundaries. 家长需要划定界限。

more.confusables: need to do（实义动词）/ need do（情态动词，多用于否定疑问）

examples: Their experiences were considerably different. 他们的经历相当不同。

more.confusables: different from（英式常用）/ different than（美式口语）/ different to（英式口语）

examples: Social support improves mental health. 社会支持改善心理健康。

more.confusables: mental（心理的）/ physical（身体的）

processes.sense: 过程（process 的复数）；处理（动词三单）
examples: Decision processes vary by person. 决策过程因人而异。

more.confusables: processes（过程）/ process（单数/处理）

answering.sense: answer 的现在分词（回答、接听）
examples: Answering the phone and writing at once. 一边接电话一边写东西。

more.confusables: answering（现在分词）/ answered（过去式）

phone.sense: 手机、电话（可数）/ 打电话
examples: Parents stare non-stop at their phones. 家长不停地盯着手机。

more.confusables: phone（电话）/ telephone（同义，正式）/ phon（音素）

writing.sense: 写作、文字（不可数）；write 的现在分词
examples: Teaching formal writing is still crucial. 教正式写作仍然关键。

more.confusables: writing（写作）/ written（过去分词）

examples: For example, texting and reading coexist. 例如，发短信和读书并存。

more.confusables: for example（插入语，缩写 e.g.）/ such as（后接名词）

examples: On the other side of the coin, there are optimists. 反过来说，也有乐观者。

more.confusables: on the other side（另一方面）/ on the other hand（另一方面，更常用）

coin.sense: 硬币（可数）/ 创造（新词）
examples: Scholars coined the term in the 1990s. 学者在 1990 年代创造了这个术语。

more.confusables: coin（硬币/创造）/ cone（圆锥）

people.sense: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
examples: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。

more.confusables: people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）

maintain.sense: 维持、保持；坚持认为（maintain that）
examples: Some maintain that multitasking is possible. 有人坚持认为多任务处理是可能的。

more.confusables: maintain（维持/主张）/ maintenance（维护，名词）
